snippet.title: UMvC3 MODS | "RETURN TO DUST!" | Blade of Scion Trailer
snippet.description:
Blade of Scion from Red Earth joins the cast in modded UMvC3!

Mod by @Shumariachi
Model - https://x.com/IttravVFX
Rigging/Colors - https://x.com/Novembermannn
Colors - https://x.com/MontNoland
Voice Actor - https://x.com/PantslessF

Direct Link to the UMvC3 Community Edition Build is included down below ⬇️

Nexusmods Link ➡️ https://tinyurl.com/596h8b57
Google Drive Link ➡️ https://tinyurl.com/mr332c2a

==============================================================

Interested in playing the mods but don't know how to install them? Here's a tutorial on how to install Clone Engine ➡ https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xzgcwX1lqrw&t=33s

(DISCLAIMER: The download above is 7+ gigabytes as it also includes custom UI, custom music, up to 20 colors for some characters, and new stages!)
